description.p: NanoTorrent is a small BitTorrent client: a Rust port of PicoTorrent by Viktor Elofsson, built on librqbit.

ul.li: DHT, UDP trackers and MSE/PE protocol encryption
Add several torrents at once, choosing which files to fetch from each
Create torrents in BitTorrent v1, v2 or hybrid format
Labels, and filters written in a small query language
Per-torrent details: files, peers with country flags, and trackers by announce tier
An optional authenticated HTTPS web interface for controlling it remotely
Available in over 40 languages, switchable without restarting

screenshot.caption: The torrent list, with the details pane below it

ul.li: Opening a torrent's download folder opened the parent directory instead, and reported nothing when it failed
The window icon fell back to a generic one on Wayland
The notification-area icon could not be created in sandboxed environments

description.p: Fixes a crash on startup: turning off the notification-area icon made the application fail to launch every time afterwards, with no way to undo it from the interface.
The "Skip 'Add torrent' dialog" preference now works - it was stored but never acted on.
Batch torrent adding in both the desktop and web interfaces, a low-disk guard, and fixes for two bugs in session persistence.
